reasoning_summary:
Phase C complete — all 3 critical bugs fixed.

TASK-0001 (BUG-001): Fixed LanceDB count desync. verify_document_vectors() replaced ANN search (default limit=10) with count_rows(filter=...). search() error recovery stripped destructive reset()+re-ingest pattern (was silently dropping prior vectors). get_all_vectors() replaced zero-vector ANN pagination with full table scan.

TASK-0002 (BUG-002): Fixed async event loop blocking. Wrapped 10+ sync calls in FastAPI handlers with asyncio.to_thread(), including rag.search(), call_local_summary(), store.get_all_vectors(), store.get_all_doc_ids(), client.chat.completions.create(), cds.search(). Converted /api/ingest_document from sync inline pipeline to BackgroundTasks. Replaced sync httpx.get() and httpx.head() with async http_client.

TASK-0003 (BUG-003): Fixed knowledge graph memory/browser freeze. Removed 768-dim vector column from get_all_vectors() return (was loaded for graph but unused). Hard-capped graph at 300 nodes with early break. Reduced default limit from 50 to 30. Added truncated flag to pagination response.
system_state_before: 3 critical bugs open. Sync calls blocking event loop. Knowledge graph loading vectors + unbounded nodes.
system_state_after: All 3 critical bugs fixed. All sync calls wrapped in asyncio.to_thread. Knowledge graph capped at 300 nodes. Pipeline sanity test passes.
